name: M6.RecipeIsometries.shift_laws
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (r : ZMod N) (a : M6.RecipeIsometries.Block N), M6.RecipeIsometries.shift N 0 a = a ∧ M6.RecipeIsometries.shift N (-r) (M6.RecipeIsometries.shift N r a) = a ∧ (M6.RecipeIsometries.shift N r a = 0 ↔ a = 0)
guidance: Unfold shift and prove function equalities coordinatewise by additive-group arithmetic. For zero iff apply the inverse shift to an equality; shift of the zero function is zero. The reverse inverse follows by using the same law at -r. Return tactic proof lines without leading by, retaining the exact frozen statement and default limits.
